Airport Station
Airport Station is an integral part of Hong Kong International Airport, and makes it easy for you to enter and exit the Airport without changing levels.
When taking the Airport Express to the Airport to catch a flight, simply stroll to the airline check-in-counter on Level 7 of Passenger Terminal. When arriving off a flight and leaving the immigration and baggage claim areas you can simply walk straight through the Greeting Hall and board a city-bound Airport Express train on the same level.

大家有冇留意虛擬服務大使Tracy已經陸續「進駐」更多車站呢?為咗慶祝Tracy「進駐」尖東站，我哋將會推出AI Tracy港鐵徽章！🎊
🤳MTR Mobile會員只要去鰂魚涌、羅湖、啟德、柯士甸、金鐘、中環或尖東站同AI Tracy講「我想要AI Tracy徽章」*，屏幕上就會顯示二維碼，掃一掃就可以收集每個站嘅專屬徽章，徽章更加會即時儲存到你嘅MTR Mobile App𠻹！
快啲過嚟同Tracy傾計，享受智能服務體驗啦！
📍虛擬服務大使Tracy位置：
鰂魚涌站：車站大堂A出口 (閘內近車站洗手間及閘外區域)
羅湖站：入境大堂 (2樓) 近入閘口 (閘外區域)
啟德站：車站大堂A出口 (閘內及閘外區域)
柯士甸站：車站大堂C出口 (閘內及閘外近入閘口)
金鐘站：車站大堂 (閘內近iCentre及閘外近入閘口)
中環站：車站大堂A出口 (閘外區域)；及通往香港站的行人隧道(L2層)(閘內區域)
尖東站：車站大堂J 出口 (閘內近升降機及閘外近售票機)
Have you noticed our Virtual Service Ambassador Tracy is now available at more MTR stations? To celebrate Tracy’s launch in East Tsim Tsui Station, we're launching exclusive AI Tracy MTR Mobile badges! 🎊
🤳MTR Mobile members can simply visit Quarry Bay, Lo Wu, Kai Tak, Austin, Admiralty, Central or East Tsim Sha Tsui Station and interact with Tracy by saying "I want an AI Tracy MTR Mobile Badge*". Scan the QR code that appears on the screen to collect each station’s designated badge. They'll instantly save to your MTR Mobile app!
Come experience our smart service today – Tracy can't wait to meet you!
📍Locations of Virtual Service Ambassador Tracy:
Quarry Bay Station: Concourse Exit A (Paid area near station toiletand Unpaid area)
Lo Wu Station: Arrival Concourse (2/F) (Unpaid area) near entry gates
Kai Tak Station: Concourse Exit A (Paid area and Unpaid area)
Austin Station: Concourse Exit C (Paid Area and Unpaid Area near entry gates)
Admiralty Station: Concourse (Paid area near iCentre and Unpaid area near entry gates)
Central Station: Concourse Exit A (Unpaid area); andTransfer Concourse pedestrian subway to Hong Kong Station (L2)(Paid area)
East Tsim Sha Tsui Station: Concourse Exit J (Paid area near lift and Unpaid area near ticketing machines)
